test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an East flowing river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Damodar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Damodar is an East flowing river.
 
• The **Damodar River** is a **Ganga tributary,** and the **Mahanadi River flows east.**
 
• The Damodar River was previously known as the **"River of Sorrows"** since it used to flood numerous areas in the districts of **Bardhaman, Hooghly, Howrah, and Medinipur.**

 Floods continue to **affect the lower Damodar Valley,** although the devastation they caused in **previous years is now history.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Narmada river rises in the state of Madhya Pradesh and flows into the Arabian Sea along Gujarat's coast.
 
• Tapi originates in Madhya Pradesh and flows into the Gulf of Khambhat on India's western coast.
 
• The Mandovi River is one of Goa's major west-flowing rivers. The river flows in a north-easterly direction for about 5 kilometres before turning westward.
